The '''T2 ion pulse cannon''', or simply '''ion pulse cannon''' was a massive experimental [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] model fitted onto the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].

==Description==
{{Quote|A weapon that neutralizes all power to our ships, rendering the targets defenseless.|Plo Koon|<ref name="RM" />}}
Rather than targeting a specific enemy vessel, the ion pulse cannon fired a massive ion burst that expanded outward from the cannon, disabling everything in its path. Plasma rotors formed a vital part of the weapon, as they were charged prior to each burst of ionized particles.<ref name="RM" /> After each shot, the technicians had to allot some time to clean up residual ionized particles in the cannon before firing again.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Unfortunately, the cannons took their tolls on the ''Malevolence'' as well. The sheer power of the cannons was very difficult to control; after firing the weapons, some of their energy would leak back into the cruiser, temporarily depowering on-board systems in the process.<ref name="Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|We tracked the mystery weapon to this system. That is when we found out it was an ion cannon|Plo Koon|<ref name="RM" />}}
[[File:Malevolence_firing_ion_pulse.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion sphere generated by the pulse cannon.]]
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] gained infamy at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when it used its ion pulse cannons to destroy entire [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] task forces. The ''Subjugator''-class was the only warship-design known to use the ion cannon model in its superstructure, as its power-requirements were highly unique.<ref name="TCWCG" />
